title: How Does Orthogonalization Adapt to the Neural Network Hessian Structure? A Gradient Self Outer-Product Analysis at Initialization
abstract: arXiv:2610.28975v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Muon orthogonalizes a weight matrix's momentum before each step, and on neural networks this simple preconditioner beats AdamW in a wide range of tasks. Existing analyses explain Muon within general optimization frameworks or on a few specific models, and many of them view orthogonalization as a preconditioner. Since the Hessian is the optimal preconditioner under a quadratic approximation of the loss, these works leave a basic question open: what makes orthogonalization suited to the Hessian of a neural network? Prior work shows that the layer-wise Hessian of a neural network is row-block diagonally dominant, and Muon's implicit preconditioner, the Kronecker product $(\mathbf{V}\mathbf{V}^\top)^{1/2}\otimes\mathbf{I}$ with $\mathbf{V}$ the momentum, has the same row-block structure exactly when $\mathbf{V}\mathbf{V}^\top$ is diagonally dominant. translated_title: 正交化如何适应神经网络的Hessian结构？基于初始化时梯度自外积的分析
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.28975v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：Muon在每一步更新前对权重矩阵的动量进行正交化，在神经网络上，这个简单的预条件器在广泛任务中的表现优于AdamW。现有分析要么在一般优化框架内解释Muon，要么只在少数特定模型上进行分析，且许多工作将正交化视为一种预条件器。由于在损失的二次近似下，Hessian是最优的预条件器，这些工作留下了一个基本问题：是什么使得正交化适合于神经网络的Hessian？先前的研究表明，神经网络的逐层Hessian是行块对角占优的，而Muon的隐式预条件器，即Kronecker积 $(\mathbf{V}\mathbf{V}^\top)^{1/2}\otimes\mathbf{I}$（其中 $\mathbf{V}$ 为动量），恰好在 $\mathbf{V}\mathbf{V}^\top$ 对角占优时具有相同的行块结构。$\mathbf{V}\mathbf{V}^\top$ 的对角占优性已在语言模型中被观察到，但……
tldr: 本文通过在初始化阶段对梯度自外积（$\mathbf{V}\mathbf{V}^\top$）的对角占优性进行分析，揭示了Muon正交化预条件器之所以有效，是因为它能匹配神经网络逐层Hessian的行块对角占优结构。
en_tdlr: By analyzing the diagonal dominance of the gradient self outer-product ($\mathbf{V}\mathbf{V}^\top$) at initialization, this paper reveals that Muon's orthogonalization preconditioner is effective because it matches the row-block diagonally dominant structure of the neural network's layer-wise Hessian.
